criteria.note: Both new endpoints reuse the identical 'email in users' -> 401 check already used by GET /api/billing; no weaker check introduced.

Already-premium guard runs unconditionally before any other logic; prorated_charge cannot go negative (days_remaining floored at max(1,...), PLANS prices fixed positive); billing_data/users are mutated only after charge_result.status == 'success' is confirmed.

renew_at is always backend-written in a fixed format (never user-supplied), so strptime cannot fail on attacker-controlled input in this diff; the app has no debug=True, so any genuinely unexpected exception returns FastAPI's default generic 500 with no stack trace.
requirements.txt and package.json are byte-identical to pre-epic; verified via git diff.
